decision.explanation: Document d1 explicitly states Collin Morikawa won the 2020 British Open, while documents d2 and d3 contain contradictory and factually incorrect claims regarding the event's cancellation and the identity of the 2019 champion (Hideki Matsuyama and Shane Lowry are both cited incorrectly as the 2019 winner in those texts, whereas the actual 2019 winner was Shane Lowry, but the 2020 event did take place). The specific claim that the 2020 British Open was canceled is false; the tournament was held at St Andrews in July 2020, and Morikawa won.
